title: The answer key grades month-over-month growth instead of the requested YoY growth
evidence: The task explicitly requests "YoY Revenue Growth returning \"NM\" where unavailable", but the golden workbook's monthly growth formulas compare consecutive months. For May-2025, Ratio Analysis!M7 is ='Income Statement'!N19/'Income Statement'!M19-1 and expects 0.0117689844393263, although May-2024 monthly revenue is unavailable. For April-2026, X7 expects 0.153640118577652 from April/March; April-2026 divided by April-2025 minus one is 0.31742359464853576 using the supplied fixture. This affects 59 monthly answer cells. The sole verifier has weight 1 and requires every modification cell to match, so correctly implementing YoY growth fails the entire check.
confirmation: In gt_06_DigiMark_golden.xlsx, Ratio Analysis row 7 monthly cells compare consecutive months (M7 is 'NM', N7 is ='Income Statement'!N19/'Income Statement'!M19-1, cached about 0.0118). The prompt asks for YoY growth with NM where unavailable, so a correct YoY answer, which would be NM for the first 1
fix: gt_06_DigiMark_golden.xlsx 'Ratio Analysis' row 7 monthly cells: M7:W7 (May-25 to Mar-26, no prior-year month) set to 'NM' like L7; X7:BS7 now compare with the same month a year earlier, e.g. X7 ='Income Statement'!Y19/'Income Statement'!M19-1 (0.3174, was 0.1536 MoM).
